# Core library: catalogue

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_catalogue.py from the code; do not edit by hand. -->

The framework every application builds on: the network, the layers (including the flow allocation layer), the model, the set-up helpers, and the general-purpose constitutive laws and heads.
Every application is set up the same way; see [Workflow](../../guide/workflow.md).

Import from `noodl.topology` and the modules named in each table. Each name links to its entry in the [API reference](../api/index.md), which gives every parameter.

## Set-up

Build the model and its starting state and inputs.

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`drivers_from`](../api/model.md#noodl.refs.drivers_from)<br><small>`noodl.refs`</small> | A drivers dictionary from `{key: {label: value}}` and/or `{key: tensor}`. |
| [`state_from`](../api/model.md#noodl.refs.state_from)<br><small>`noodl.refs`</small> | A state dictionary, as `drivers_from` builds drivers. |
| [`initial_drivers`](../api/model.md#noodl.refs.initial_drivers)<br><small>`noodl.refs`</small> | A copy of the model's driver template (`model.driver_template`, which an application's `build_model` records), then `values` (see `drivers_from`). |
| [`check_setup`](../api/model.md#noodl.validation.check_setup)<br><small>`noodl.validation`</small> | Check `model` and, when given, `state` and `drivers`; return a `SetupReport`. |

## Layers and model

The conservation layers and the model that steps them.

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`Network`](../api/topology.md#noodl.topology.Network)<br><small>`noodl.topology`</small> | Directed multigraph with typed edges and tensor-valued topology operators. |
| [`Ports`](../api/model.md#noodl.model.Ports)<br><small>`noodl.model`</small> | What a coupled or external model may prescribe and read. |
| [`Model`](../api/model.md#noodl.model.Model)<br><small>`noodl.model`</small> | Layers on one `Network`, stepped together. |
| [`AllocatedFlowLayer`](../api/layers.md#noodl.layers.allocation.AllocatedFlowLayer)<br><small>`noodl.layers`</small> | Flows allocated by rule, not by a potential: each edge's requested flow is clipped to the arc's capacity and the receiving node's free storage, one explicit step at a time, conserving storage exactly (WSIMOD's push/pull semantics). |
| [`KirchhoffLayer`](../api/layers.md#noodl.layers.kirchhoff.KirchhoffLayer)<br><small>`noodl.layers`</small> | Flows driven by a potential (pressure, head): solves the flow balance at the interior nodes for the interior potentials by Newton's method, with the constitutive laws on its edge kinds, the head driver added to the potential differences, and prescribed potentials at its boundary nodes; differentiable through the converged solution. |
| [`TransportLayer`](../api/layers.md#noodl.layers.transport.TransportLayer)<br><small>`noodl.layers`</small> | dx/dt = M x + N x_b + sources / capacity on this layer's ACTIVE interior nodes. |
| [`CoupledModel`](../api/model.md#noodl.couple.CoupledModel)<br><small>`noodl.couple`</small> | What `union` returns: several models stepped together, exchanging values each step. |

## Constitutive laws

The relation between the flow through an edge and the potential difference across it.

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`AffinityFan`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.fan.AffinityFan)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | A fan curve run at another speed and air density, by the fan laws (ContamX's performance-curve fan). |
| [`AirDuct`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.air_duct.AirDuct)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | A duct segment, F (kg/s) from dp (Pa): Darcy-Weisbach with ContamX's friction factor. |
| [`Conductance`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.conductance.Conductance)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | q = g dp, the linear branch law used for thermal conduction and passive exchange; `g` is in the flow unit per unit of potential (W/K for heat, kg/s per Pa for air). |
| [`CubicSplineFlow`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.curve.CubicSplineFlow)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | An airflow element given by measured points, fitted as ContamX fits them (`SplineCurve`): CONTAM's cubic-spline elements. |
| [`Damper`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.damper.Damper)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | Separate power-law coefficient and exponent for each flow direction: `C_pos`/`n_pos` for dp > 0 and `C_neg`/`n_neg` for dp < 0, each as in `PowerLaw` (`C` in the flow unit per Pa^n, `n` dimensionless). |
| [`DoorCompartment`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.door_discretized.DoorCompartment)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | One compartment of ``Buildings.Airflow.Multizone.DoorDiscretizedOpen`` per edge. |
| [`DoorPortStream`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.door_discretized.DoorPortStream)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | One port stream of a whole discretised door, as one edge from side A to side B. |
| [`Duct`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.duct.Duct)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | Colebrook duct: F(dp) with friction from the Colebrook equation, laminar below Re_t. |
| [`DuctTerminal`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.air_duct.DuctTerminal)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | A duct terminal, the zero-length duct between a junction and its zone, F (kg/s) from dp (Pa), as ContamX computes it. |
| [`FanCurve`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.fan.FanCurve)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | Cubic pressure-flow curve inverted for q given dp on [0, q_max]: `coeffs` are (a0, a1, a2, a3) of P(q) = a0 + a1 q + a2 q^2 + a3 q^3 in Pa for q in the flow unit, and `q_max` is the largest flow the curve covers, in that unit. |
| [`FixedFlow`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.fixed.FixedFlow)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | q = q0 regardless of dp (`q0` in the flow unit); dflow = 0; linear_init = (q0, 0). |
| [`FixedVolumeFlow`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.fixed.FixedVolumeFlow)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | F = Q rho_up whatever dp: a constant volume flow `volume_flow` Q (m3/s, one per edge) delivered as mass flow at the density of the node it draws from (`src` when Q >= 0, `tgt` otherwise), read from `drivers[rho_key]` (full node order). |
| [`OpenDoor`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.door.OpenDoor)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | ``Buildings.Airflow.Multizone.DoorOpen``: one direction of the always-open door. |
| [`OperableDoor`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.door.OperableDoor)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | ``Buildings.Airflow.Multizone.DoorOperable``: the door blended between open and closed by the opening signal ``y`` read from ``drivers[y_key]``. |
| [`OperableDoorCompartment`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.door_discretized.OperableDoorCompartment)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | One compartment of ``Buildings.Airflow.Multizone.DoorDiscretizedOperable`` per edge, blended between the open door and the closed crack by ``y = drivers[y_key]``. |
| [`PowerLaw`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.powerlaw.PowerLaw)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | q = C sign(dp) \|dp\|^n, laminar-blended or smoothly regularised near dp = 0. |
| [`PrescribedFlow`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.fixed.PrescribedFlow)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | F = drivers[key] whatever dp: a flow (kg/s, one value per edge of the kind) that a closure or an input prescribes every step, e.g. an air handler's supply flows. |
| [`Quadratic`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.quadratic.Quadratic)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | q = sign(dp) * 2\|dp\| / (sqrt(a^2 + 4 b \|dp\|) + a): the inverse of dp = a q + b \|q\| q, with `dp` in Pa, `a` in Pa per flow unit and `b` in Pa per flow unit squared. |
| [`RegularizedPowerLaw`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.powerlaw_regularized.RegularizedPowerLaw)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | MBL's regularised power law, ``q = C sign(dp) \|dp\|^m``, volume or mass form. |
| [`Scaled`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.scaled.Scaled)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | F = s F_law: `law`'s flow times the dimensionless multiplier `drivers[key]`. |
| [`SplineFlowTable`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.table.SplineFlowTable)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | MBL's tabulated flow law: a monotone cubic Hermite spline through ``(dp, flow)`` knots, linearly extrapolated outside them; ``flow(dp)`` always returns MASS flow in kg/s. |
| [`UpstreamDensityPowerLaw`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.upstream.UpstreamDensityPowerLaw)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | `PowerLaw` with `C` scaled by `(rho_upstream / rho_ref) ** m`, upstream by `sign(dp)`. |

## Heads

Terms added to an edge's potential difference (stack, wind, drag).

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`DoorCompartmentHead`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.door_discretized.DoorCompartmentHead)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | The hydrostatic head of one compartment of a discretised door. |
| [`DriverHead`](../api/laws.md#noodl.heads.DriverHead)<br><small>`noodl.heads`</small> | A head read from a driver: the pre-computed, already batched value `drivers[key]`, one value per edge of `kind`. |
| [`Stack`](../api/laws.md#noodl.heads.Stack)<br><small>`noodl.heads`</small> | Hydrostatic stack term (CONTAM TN 1887r1 eq. 17 with eq. 64-65 at the path elevation). |
| [`DuctStack`](../api/laws.md#noodl.heads.DuctStack)<br><small>`noodl.heads`</small> | Hydrostatic term of a duct segment between two junctions: the air column at the density of the junctions' MEAN TEMPERATURE (as ContamX computes it), which at one pressure is the harmonic mean of the two node densities. |
| [`WindProfile`](../api/laws.md#noodl.heads.WindProfile)<br><small>`noodl.heads`</small> | CONTAM wind pressure profile: Cp versus relative wind angle, periodic in the angle. |
| [`Wind`](../api/laws.md#noodl.heads.Wind)<br><small>`noodl.heads`</small> | Wind pressure on envelope paths (CONTAM TN 1887r1 section 3.15). |

## Closures

Functions of the state that compute drivers each step (densities, flows, levels).

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`AlgebraicClosure`](../api/model.md#noodl.contracts.AlgebraicClosure)<br><small>`noodl.contracts`</small> | A closure that only computes drivers from the state and the drivers: called as `closure(state, drivers)`, it returns the driver entries it adds or replaces. |
| [`IntegratingClosure`](../api/model.md#noodl.contracts.IntegratingClosure)<br><small>`noodl.contracts`</small> | A closure that advances state of its own over the step (`integrates = True`). |
| [`ClosureSpec`](../api/model.md#noodl.contracts.ClosureSpec)<br><small>`noodl.contracts`</small> | A closure and its declarations, read once by `closure_spec`. |
| [`EdgeHeads`](../api/laws.md#noodl.heads.EdgeHeads)<br><small>`noodl.heads`</small> | Adds up head terms (stack, wind, drag, a head read from a driver) on the edges of one potential layer and writes the total, in the layer's edge order, as the driver `"<layer>.edge_head"`; the layer adds it to every edge's potential difference. |

## Sources and storage

Nodal sources, withdrawals and storage.

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`LinearStorage`](../api/laws.md#noodl.storage.LinearStorage)<br><small>`noodl.storage`</small> | S = C phi with a constant capacity C per entry (a capacitor to ground, a cylindrical tank of area A). |

## Files

Readers and writers of other tools' file formats.

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`write_at`](../api/model.md#noodl.layout.write_at)<br><small>`noodl.layout`</small> | `target` with `value` written (`add=True`: ADDED) at node `position`, in the caller's own layout (reduced `(..., n)` or stacked `(..., n, 1)`) but not necessarily its own shape: a batched `value` written into an unbatched `target` broadcasts the target up to the value's batch. |

## Other classes

Supporting types.

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`StepContext`](../api/model.md#noodl.contracts.StepContext)<br><small>`noodl.contracts`</small> | What a state transition needs from the model: the interval it must integrate over (`None` under `steady()`, which an integrating closure refuses) and, when the caller tracks it, the time at the start of the step. |
| [`ClosureAttribute`](../api/model.md#noodl.contracts.ClosureAttribute)<br><small>`noodl.contracts`</small> | One optional attribute of a closure: its name, the type it must have, what it defaults to when absent, what it means and which code consumes it. |
| [`Field`](../api/model.md#noodl.refs.Field)<br><small>`noodl.refs`</small> | A state or driver key that also knows the layout of the tensor stored under it. |
| [`LayerRef`](../api/model.md#noodl.refs.LayerRef)<br><small>`noodl.refs`</small> | One registered layer of a model, with its keys as discoverable `Field` attributes. |
| [`KeyOwnership`](../api/model.md#noodl.refs.KeyOwnership)<br><small>`noodl.refs`</small> | Who writes and who reads one key of a model: `writers` and `readers` are tuples of `"layer <name>"`, `"closure <label>"` or `"caller"` (the dictionary the caller gives). |
| [`LayerRefs`](../api/model.md#noodl.refs.LayerRefs)<br><small>`noodl.refs`</small> | Registered layer name -> `LayerRef`, plus the model's closure-carried keys. |
| [`Issue`](../api/model.md#noodl.validation.Issue)<br><small>`noodl.validation`</small> | One finding: `level` is `"error"`, `"warning"` or `"info"`; `key` the key concerned, if any. |
| [`InputRow`](../api/model.md#noodl.validation.InputRow)<br><small>`noodl.validation`</small> | One known key: what is expected and what was given. |
| [`SetupReport`](../api/model.md#noodl.validation.SetupReport)<br><small>`noodl.validation`</small> | The result of `check_setup`. |
| [`UndefinedSteadyState`](../api/layers.md#noodl.layers.transport.UndefinedSteadyState)<br><small>`noodl.layers`</small> | A steady transport solve has no answer: a stored node keeps everything that enters it (nothing leaves it, or it belongs to a closed group whose contents never reach a boundary outflow, a removal or a filter loss). |
| [`AirMedium`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.media.AirMedium)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | An air medium's default state and the two densities its flow elements need. |
| [`LawContext`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.base.LawContext)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | What a dynamic or implicit constitutive law needs besides its own edge values. |
| [`SplineCurve`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.curve.SplineCurve)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | A measured curve y(x) fitted as ContamX fits it (see the module docstring). |
| [`Conversion`](../api/model.md#noodl.couple.Conversion)<br><small>`noodl.couple`</small> | One registered conversion and the UNITS it maps between, `(from_unit, to_unit, fn)`. |
| [`ValueLink`](../api/model.md#noodl.couple.ValueLink)<br><small>`noodl.couple`</small> | One shared-node value relationship. |
| [`DriverAlias`](../api/model.md#noodl.couple.DriverAlias)<br><small>`noodl.couple`</small> | One driver value shared across models: `source` is authoritative; every target is overwritten from it through that target's own registered conversion (or none). |

## Functions

Calculations and helpers.

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`closure_spec`](../api/model.md#noodl.contracts.closure_spec)<br><small>`noodl.contracts`</small> | Read `closure`'s declarations into a `ClosureSpec`: the only reader of the closure attributes (`CLOSURE_ATTRIBUTES`). |
| [`call_closure`](../api/model.md#noodl.contracts.call_closure)<br><small>`noodl.contracts`</small> | Call a closure (or its `ClosureSpec`) by the one dispatch rule: three arguments for an integrating closure, two otherwise. |
| [`reaction_species_columns`](../api/model.md#noodl.contracts.reaction_species_columns)<br><small>`noodl.contracts`</small> | A `Reaction`'s optional `species_columns` (the same member as a closure's), `{}` when it declares none. |
| [`check_species_columns`](../api/model.md#noodl.contracts.check_species_columns)<br><small>`noodl.contracts`</small> | Raise `ValueError` unless every `{layer: {name: column}}` in `declared` names a transport layer of `transport`, has `column < n_species`, and, when the layer has `species_names`, `species_names[column] == name`. |
| [`batch_shape`](../api/model.md#noodl.layout.batch_shape)<br><small>`noodl.layout`</small> | The batch shape of `x`: its shape without its last `n_trailing` physical dimensions. |
| [`broadcast_batch`](../api/model.md#noodl.layout.broadcast_batch)<br><small>`noodl.layout`</small> | Broadcast the batch shapes of `items`, each `(tensor, number of trailing physical dims)`. |
| [`per_instance`](../api/model.md#noodl.layout.per_instance)<br><small>`noodl.layout`</small> | A float, or a tensor with one value per instance `(B...)`, as `(B..., 1, ...)` with `n_trailing` trailing singleton axes, in `like`'s dtype and device. |
| [`is_stacked`](../api/model.md#noodl.layout.is_stacked)<br><small>`noodl.layout`</small> | True when `x` is in STACKED layout `(..., n, K)`: at least `min_dim` dimensions (never fewer than 2) and trailing shape `(n, K)`. |
| [`as_stacked`](../api/model.md#noodl.layout.as_stacked)<br><small>`noodl.layout`</small> | `(x as (..., n, K), reduced?)` by the one rule: stacked `(..., n, K)` first; for `K == 1` also reduced `(..., n)`, returned with a trailing axis and `reduced=True`. |
| [`as_layout`](../api/model.md#noodl.layout.as_layout)<br><small>`noodl.layout`</small> | `x_stacked` `(..., n, 1)` back in the caller's layout: `(..., n)` if `reduced`, unchanged otherwise (the inverse of `as_stacked` for one species). |
| [`reduced_single`](../api/model.md#noodl.layout.reduced_single)<br><small>`noodl.layout`</small> | A single-species tensor in REDUCED layout `(..., n)`, whether it came stacked `(..., n, 1)` or reduced. |
| [`species_columns`](../api/model.md#noodl.layout.species_columns)<br><small>`noodl.layout`</small> | The column of each `wanted` species name in the `declared` order (a layer's `species_names`). |
| [`normalize_unit`](../api/model.md#noodl.refs.normalize_unit)<br><small>`noodl.refs`</small> | A unit string in one canonical spelling, for comparison only (this is not a units library: nothing is converted, and two different units never compare equal). |
| [`units_agree`](../api/model.md#noodl.refs.units_agree)<br><small>`noodl.refs`</small> | Whether two unit strings are the same unit up to `normalize_unit`'s spellings. |
| [`input_field`](../api/model.md#noodl.refs.input_field)<br><small>`noodl.refs`</small> | A `Field` for an input a closure, reaction, law or head term reads itself (a wind speed, an inflow), as a closure's `input_specs` or a builder's `model.input_specs` declares it. |
| [`input_unit_declarations`](../api/model.md#noodl.refs.input_unit_declarations)<br><small>`noodl.refs`</small> | `(origin, key, unit)` for every input a model, closure or reaction declares in `input_specs`, in declaration order; `unit` is `""` when the spec gives none. |
| [`required_state_keys`](../api/model.md#noodl.refs.required_state_keys)<br><small>`noodl.refs`</small> | The state keys `Model.step` reads from the step-start state. |
| [`active_interior`](../api/layers.md#noodl.layers.transport.active_interior)<br><small>`noodl.layers`</small> | Split the non-boundary nodes of `net` into the ones `kinds` touch and the ones it does not: `(interior_idx, inactive_idx)`, both in NODE order, both excluding `boundary`. |
| [`Orifice`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.powerlaw.Orifice)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | PowerLaw(C = Cd * A * sqrt(2 / rho), n = 0.5): the sharp-edged orifice equation, as a VOLUME flow in m3/s from `Cd` (dimensionless discharge coefficient), `A` (m2) and `rho` (kg/m3). |
| [`air_viscosity`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.air_duct.air_viscosity)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | Dynamic viscosity of air (Pa s) at temperature `T` (K): ContamX's linear law, 1.81625e-5 + 4.92859e-8 (T - 293.15), valid between 253 and 333 K. |
| [`discretized_door`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.door_discretized.discretized_door)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | One ``DoorDiscretizedOpen`` as ``nCom`` edges of ``kind``: the compartment element and its head term. |
| [`discretized_operable_door`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.door_discretized.discretized_operable_door)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | One ``DoorDiscretizedOperable`` as ``nCom`` edges of ``kind``; see :func:`discretized_door`. |
| [`effective_leakage_area`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.powerlaw_regularized.effective_leakage_area)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | A regularised power law from an effective leakage area `L` (m2), after MBL. |
| [`medium`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.media.medium)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | Look up one of the three air media, by physical name or by Modelica class path. |
| [`open_door_pair`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.door.open_door_pair)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | Both edges of one ``DoorOpen`` (or of several, with per-door ``src``/``tgt``): the ``"ab"`` edge (path 1) with kind ``f"{kind}_ab"`` and the ``"ba"`` edge (path 2) with kind ``f"{kind}_ba"``, sharing every keyword argument of :class:`OpenDoor`. |
| [`operable_door_pair`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.door.operable_door_pair)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | Both edges of one ``DoorOperable``; see :func:`open_door_pair`. |
| [`power_law_coefficient`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.powerlaw_regularized.power_law_coefficient)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | ``Coefficient_V_flow.mo``/``Coefficient_m_flow.mo``: ``C``/``k`` and ``m`` given directly, with no further formula -- a direct pass-through to :class:`RegularizedPowerLaw`. |
| [`power_law_from_point`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.powerlaw_regularized.power_law_from_point)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | A regularised power law fitted to one measured (dp, m_flow) pair, after MBL. |
| [`power_law_from_points`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.powerlaw_regularized.power_law_from_points)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | A regularised power law fitted to two measured (dp, m_flow) pairs, after MBL. |
| [`regularized_orifice`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.powerlaw_regularized.regularized_orifice)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | A regularised power law for a sharp-edged orifice of area `A` (m2), after MBL. |
| [`step_rate`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.base.step_rate)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | The rate at which a stored quantity changes over one implicit step: `change / dt` (backward Euler) or `2 change / dt - previous` (trapezoidal, `previous` = the rate at the step start). |
| [`step_rate_factor`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.base.step_rate_factor)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | d step_rate / d change: `1/dt` (backward Euler) or `2/dt` (trapezoidal). |
| [`apply_conversion`](../api/model.md#noodl.couple.apply_conversion)<br><small>`noodl.couple`</small> | `value` unchanged if `name` is None; the registered conversion otherwise. |
| [`transport_boundary_inflow`](../api/model.md#noodl.couple.transport_boundary_inflow)<br><small>`noodl.couple`</small> | Net mass INFLOW, `(...,)`, at the boundary node `boundary_idx[node_position]`, in a transport layer's own units, for a SINGLE-SPECIES layer (`x_interior`/`x_boundary` are `(..., n_i)`/`(..., n_b)`, never `(..., n_i, K)`). |
| [`union`](../api/model.md#noodl.couple.union)<br><small>`noodl.couple`</small> | Couple `models` by exchanging the driver/state values `shared` names, WITHOUT merging any model's `Network`, layers, or closures. |

## Base classes (for extending)

Subclass these to add a constitutive law, head term, closure, reaction, withdrawal or node storage; see [Extending noodl](../../project/extending/index.md).

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`Reaction`](../api/layers.md#noodl.layers.reaction.Reaction)<br><small>`noodl.layers`</small> | A local, per-node nonlinear map applied to the state after a transport step (or before it, under `Model(reaction_order="before_transport")`). |
| [`ConstitutiveLaw`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.base.ConstitutiveLaw)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | Abstract branch law: flow as a function of potential difference. |
| [`ImplicitLaw`](../api/laws.md#noodl.elements.base.ImplicitLaw)<br><small>`noodl.elements`</small> | An implicit law: a law whose flow is an unknown of the layer (an ideal source, a flow-controlled pipe, an inductance). |
| [`HeadTerm`](../api/laws.md#noodl.heads.HeadTerm)<br><small>`noodl.heads`</small> | One additive head on the edges of one kind, computed from the drivers only. |
| [`NodeWithdrawal`](../api/laws.md#noodl.withdrawals.NodeWithdrawal)<br><small>`noodl.withdrawals`</small> | A flow leaving the network at nodes that depends on the potential of the same layer (pressure-driven demand, a leak): a potential-dependent withdrawal at a fixed set of nodes. |
| [`NodeStorage`](../api/laws.md#noodl.storage.NodeStorage)<br><small>`noodl.storage`</small> | An amount stored at nodes as a function of each node's own potential; the layer turns its change over a step into a withdrawal (positive into storage). |
